questions.stem: A 20-year-old woman comes to the OPD due to 3 days of malodorous vaginal discharge and severe vulvar pruritus. The patient is sexually active and had a copper-containing intrauterine device placed for contraception last year. Pelvic examination shows a thin, frothy, and green vaginal discharge with marked vulvar and vaginal erythema. Vaginal discharge pH is 5.5. The intrauterine device strings are visualized and protrude through the cervical os. Microscopic examination of this patient's vaginal discharge will most likely reveal which of the following?
